why: [R-GAP-01] with the ratchet of [R-ENF-02]. Measured 08-09-2026, the first time anything held a study's committed spot to the latest supplied price and to its own date: of 24 study directories TWELVE commit no readable spot date and SIX are struck against a price that is no longer the latest. The rule has required both since 03-Sep-2026 and nothing was checking either — check_valuation_gap reads each study's OWN committed spot, which is the right question for whether a study was audited before it shipped and is satisfied just as happily by a month-old price. THE TWO FAILURES ARE LISTED APART BECAUSE THEY ARE REPAIRED APART: a missing date on a current price is a RECORD fix that moves no number, and a superseded price is a RE-STRIKE that moves the gap and can push a gap review out of its own tolerance. Every entry carries its measurement rather than a bare name, so the debt is countable rather than remembered, and the list may only ever SHORTEN (--prune).
